description: This Java source file defines the 'FieldAnswer' entity class for the OpenMRS platform, representing an answer to a specific field. It includes mappings to a database table, attributes with annotations, getters and setters, and logic for tracking modifications.

classes.name: FieldAnswer
classes.description: Represents an answer to a specific field in the OpenMRS system. It maintains references to a concept, creator, and field, along with metadata like creation date and a dirty flag for modifications. It extends BaseOpenmrsObject.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Deprecated method indicating if the FieldAnswer has been modified. Delegates to getDirty().

methods.name: getDirty
methods.description: Returns whether the FieldAnswer has been modified since last clean.

methods.name: setClean
methods.description: Resets the dirty flag to false.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the associated Concept object and marks the instance as dirty.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Retrieves the User who created this answer.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator User and marks the instance as dirty.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Retrieves the date when this answer was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date and marks as dirty.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Sets the associated Field and marks the instance as dirty.
